response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), overall_sum AS (SELECT SUM(customer_total) as total_revenue FROM customer_totals), customer_shares AS (SELECT customer_total, customer_total / (SELECT total_revenue FROM overall_sum) as share FROM customer_totals), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM customer_shares), above_avg AS (SELECT cs.customer_total, cs.share FROM customer_shares cs CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE cs.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(customer_total) as average_total_spent, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG((share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) / (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) as average_relative_difference FROM above_avg

assumptions.assumption: The 'average relative difference' is computed relative to the overall average share across all customers (the threshold used for filtering), not relative to the average share of the filtered customers.

alternatives.interpretation: The 'average relative difference' is computed relative to the average share of only the filtered customers themselves: AVG((share − filtered_avg_share) / filtered_avg_share)
